entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's for the VeloBand Pulse.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered about twelve days ago. Before we process anything, I need to understand the reason for the return. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken, it's just... it's really hard to use. It's not what I thought it would be.

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. Can you tell me a little more about what part you're finding confusing? That will help me understand the problem better.
The live display during a ride. I expected more than just a heart rate number. I can't see my cadence or anything else. I skimmed the user manual and couldn't find a way to change it.

Ah, that's a great question and a very common point of confusion. I apologize if the user manual wasn't clear on that point. The good news is, that screen is fully customizable. Do you happen to have your phone nearby? I can walk you through setting it up in less than a minute.
Fine. I have the app open now. What do I do?
Perfect. From the app's home screen, tap on 'Equipment' at the bottom. Then select your VeloBand Pulse. You should see an option that says 'Live Data Screens.' Go ahead and tap that.
Okay... Equipment... VeloBand Pulse... 'Live Data Screens'... I see it.

Excellent. From there, you can tap on each data field to change it to whatever you'd like to see—cadence, speed, power zones, and so on. You can even set up multiple screens to swipe through during your workout.
...Oh. I see. I can just change it to 'Cadence' here. And add 'Speed' to the second slot. Huh. Well, that's actually what I wanted it to do.
I'm glad to hear it! Does that resolve the issue for you?
Yes, it does. That solves the problem. I won't need to return it then. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'll pass your feedback along to our team to make that feature easier to find in the setup guide. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything.
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
